where_to_check: Every output JSON runtime_precision must equal the candidate precision config before interpreting text. Inspect representative and all-row values; any mismatch invalidates the candidate run.

per_seed_trace_counter_assertions.note: Counters are recorded by timed_free_generate around existing synchronous token-out readbacks; no added synchronization or profiler. Confirm captures do not increase during decode.

post_run_records: cap outcomes: completed vs still progressing/inconclusive
precision_scope: Only lm_head compute fidelity changes from LoFi to HiFi2. The raw weight-group label changes bfp8_lofi to bfp8, but both use bfloat8_b storage; all other precision fields and max_seq_len262144 stay fixed.
